title: Image-only scanned invoice requiring OCR + structure recovery
routingReason: PDF with no extractable text layer — MarkItDown returns near-empty output; router must detect the empty text layer and escalate to Docling with OCR enabled.

tokens.note: OCR artifacts (spaced digits '08 1 44', O/0 confusion '1,734.OO') must be corrected; totals must arithmetically reconcile (subtotal + tax = total) or the pipeline flags a warning.
